description.value: Dragon Palace is a long-running family restaurant in Chetwynd, BC, founded in 1988 by Bill and Christine, whose combined backgrounds in Hong Kong kitchens and Cantonese opera give the place an unusually warm character. The menu spans authentic Chinese dishes, burgers, steaks, and seafood, making it one of the most versatile sit-down options in Northern BC's Peace region. A 2016 renovation added a full bar and wine display, and a 2025 in-house coffee roasting operation means cyclists can fuel up with specialty coffee alongside a full meal.
